messages:
Marta Gomez: Hey @people-ops — got an EOB that says my specialist claim was denied as out-of-network because the providerNPI on the claim doesn’t match the one on file. I saw the appointment was with Dr. Min Lee at Northside Ortho (same clinic I always go to). How do I get this corrected?

People Ops: Sorry for the hassle, Marta. We can help escalate to Claims. Can you upload the EOB (explanation of benefits), the clinic invoice, and any proof of visit (appointment confirmation or after-visit summary)? Also ask the provider to send an itemized bill with the correct NPI and a short attestation that Dr. Min Lee saw you on the service date.

Marta Gomez: Uploaded EOB_2026.pdf and avs_lee.jpg. The clinic sent an initial bill but it shows a different billing NPI (maybe their billing company). I asked them to generate a provider-corrected invoice and they said they canbut need payor contact info.

Claims Team: Quick checklist to get claim reprocessed:
- EOB (root cause of denial)
- Corrected itemized invoice showing rendering provider name and NPI
- Proof of visit (AVS or appointment confirmation)
- If billing office used a third-party Biller, a signed attestation from the clinic stating which NPI should be used for patient responsibility and insurer billing
- If denial was due to prior auth mismatch, provide prior auth number or confirmation

Claims Team: Send corrected docs to claims@redwood.com with subject:

Provider NPI Correction Request  Marta Gomez  Claim 1777777777

Provider Billing - Dr. Lee: Hi Marta  Northside Ortho billing here. We saw your note and will create a corrected invoice with the rendering NPI. We can also send a signed attestation letter on clinic letterhead confirming Dr. Min Lee rendered services on 2026-05-02. We need the insurer contact/email to send the corrected invoice directly.

People Ops: Please have the clinic send the corrected invoice and attestation to claims@redwood.com and cc benefits@redwood.com. If they want a fax number use +1-555-0101 (secure claims fax). We recommend they include the original claim ID listed on your EOB.

Marta Gomez: Done — provider sent corrected_invoice_lee.pdf to claims@redwood.com and cc'd me. They also included a signed attestation.

Claims Team: Received corrected invoice. Were opening an appeal and will route the correction to adjudication. Timeline: initial intake confirmation within 48 hours, adjudication decision usually within 7-14 business days. If we reprocess we will issue an updated EOB and any refund/adjustment.

Benefits Bot: Tip: you can speed things up if the provider's corrected invoice includes a clear mapping of billed CPT/HCPCS codes to line items and a statement "Rendering provider NPI: xxxxxxxxxx" on letterhead. Also include the phone contact for the clinic billing manager.

Claims Team: FYI Marta, we noticed a secondary issue: the original claim had a missing taxonomy code causing a mismatch with provider directories. We asked the billing office to include the taxonomy with the corrected invoice. That helps network matching.

Marta Gomez: Thanks all. One more Q: will this count against my in-network deductible if it takes 2+ weeks? I need to know whether I should pay the clinic balance now.

Claims Team: Good question. If the claim reprocesses as in-network we will retroactively apply payments and any patient responsibility adjustment. If you get a balance notice from the clinic, ask them to mark it "pending insurer adjudication" and avoid aggressive collections until 30 days after our reprocess. If they insist, save the correspondence and upload it and we can send a verification letter to the clinic.

Provider Billing - Dr. Lee: Clinic note  we marked Marta's account as "awaiting insurer re-adjudication" and froze collections for 30 days. Happy to provide any extra docs claims needs.

People Ops: Looping closed: Claims escalated to adjudication under appeal code ADJ-177777-A. We'll update this thread when the updated EOB posts. Marta, if you get additional notices, drop them here and well attach to the appeal. :thumbsup:

Marta Gomez: Appreciate it  that relieves stress. Thank you everyone.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: keep copies of corrected invoices in the portal under "Provider Corrections" so future claims match automatically.
